input: left and right are integers satisfying 1 <= left <= right <=10000. Integers are plain int, excluding bool; lists and strings are ordinary list/str values, not subclasses. No concurrent mutation, getters or modified standard built-ins are allowed. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Declared size bounds are not a guarantee of available memory or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: A fresh ascending sequence of all integers in the inclusive interval [left,right] divisible by each of their decimal digits. Any digit zero disqualifies a number. Repeated equal digits are tested normally; no values are repeated in output.
mutation_aliasing: No mutable input exists. Only a fresh result container escapes; each helper call uses private scalar remaining/digit state. Calls retain no shared mutable state.
numeric: Candidate values are positive and at most 10000. Short-circuiting rejects digit zero before remainder by that digit can occur. Division by 10 and flooring are exact for these small integers. The terminal loop increment right+1 is at most 10001 and exact. No zero/negative candidate is admitted to the helper contract.
complexity: O(R*D + 1) time for R = right-left+1 and D <=5 decimal digits, O(1) auxiliary state and O(K + 1) result storage for K qualifying numbers. Digit extraction uses arithmetic rather than allocating per-number strings; each qualifying number is appended once.

helpers.name: is_self_dividing
helpers.contract: For a positive integer at most 10000, extract digits right-to-left; reject zero or a digit that does not divide the original value, otherwise continue until all digits are consumed.
helpers.cost: The full helper definition is 231 UTF-8 bytes including indentation and terminal newline, already included in complete source bytes. At most 5 digit iterations, O(1) live state; every candidate invokes the fully included helper and all extraction/modulo work is charged.
